question: How large was the 2025 measles outbreak in Texas, and how many deaths were reported?
text: The 2025 West Texas measles outbreak had **762 confirmed cases**, including **99 hospitalizations**. **Two school-aged children died.** The Texas Department of State Health Services declared the outbreak over on August 18, 2025. ([dshs.texas.gov](https://www.dshs.texas.gov/news-alerts/texas-announces-end-west-texas-measles-outbreak?utm_source=openai))
